newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Lippo no comment on Prime Bank buy report.
newsitem.headline: Lippo no comment on Prime Bank buy report.

text.p: Officials at a Lippo Group affiliate on Tuesday declined comment on media reports that the Indonesian firm was negotiating with Philippines' Prime Savings Bank on buying a stake.
"No comment," an official at the Export-Import Bank of the Philippines told Reuters. Lippo has a 40 percent stake in Export-Import Bank.

A spokeswoman for Prime Savings Bank, a thift, said she could neither confirm nor deny the reports. However, she said the bank was on the lookout for a possible tie-up with either local or foreign partners.
Central Bank deputy governor Alberto Reyes said he was not aware of any talks between the two banks.
Lippo recently sought a stake in another Philippine thrift, the financially troubled Monte de Piedad & Savings Bank, but was outbid by Singapore's Keppel Corp Ltd.
